name: digitalai-release-mcp
description: Connect Claude to your Digital.ai Release instance: search and manage releases, templates, tasks, variables and more.
long_description: Gives Claude access to the MCP server built into Digital.ai Release (26.1.5+). Claude can list and inspect releases and templates, create releases from templates, start releases, manage folders, phases, tasks, gates, variables and configurations, and read activity logs — all with the permissions of the Release user whose Personal Access Token you configure. Mutating tools respect the Release MCP server's read-only mode.

release_url.title: Release server URL
release_url.description: https://release.mycompany.com — the base URL of your Release instance. — If your server uses a non-default servlet path or context root, paste the full MCP endpoint URL instead.

personal_access_token.title: Personal Access Token
personal_access_token.description: Create one in Release under User profile > Access tokens. Claude acts with this user's permissions.
